facts.name: Frederick L. Koberlein Jr.
facts.assignment: Profile: Columbia Circuit Civil, one-half of all cases; domestic relations/DOR petitioner A–K; juvenile delinquency/truancy/TIPP. Dixie domestic relations/DOR and protective injunctions. Routine civil operating review here, limited noncivil scope.

contact.contact_note: Shared office/assistant phone; no personal judge email. PDF Tilena Gutshall, profile includes middle initial J.; directory calls location Room256, profile/PDF Suite256.

procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Email JA; copy parties unless lawful ex parte exception. Subject must identify case number/name and matter. Profile also offers inquiry form.
procedure_checklist.hearing_scheduling: Coordinate needed combined hearing time, then email JA for dates. File/serve notice immediately and within two business days after agreement; notify JA by email and phone of cancellation and file/serve cancellation.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Linked hearing-request instruction requires verification of Rule1.202 certificate or unrepresented opposing side, subject to listed exemptions; otherwise hearing will not be set.
procedure_checklist.motion_submissions: Hearing notice identifies motion title and clerk document number. General hearing materials due three business days before hearing; specific courtesy-copy language separately preserved.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email .docx to JA, provide parties a copy and state agreement/disagreement; due when court directs. Mail/hand delivery permitted for self-represented litigants excused from email service.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Aids/case law required; PDF/A or punched binder. Email up to25pages; mail/hand-deliver larger submissions. Page8 requires reasonable advance time but literally says “In no instance should case law be submitted no less than four (4) business days”; wording preserved without interpretation.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Zoom hybrid courtroom; remote appearance requires motion at least15days before hearing. Notice includes meeting ID and dial-in. Private quiet location, no moving vehicle, camera on/microphone muted unless instructed otherwise.

facts.review_scope: Ten-page original retained; practical operating review sectionsA–E/pages1–8 plus access/interpreter links onpage10. Conferral one-page instruction reviewed. Page8 deadline visually checked. Specialized motion/trial/exhibit requirements and family worksheet not substantively abstracted.
facts.summary: Civil hearings are coordinated through JA; email Word orders and use page-count-specific delivery for courtesy materials. Remote participation requires advance motion.

conflicts.summary: Page4 general hearing materials deadline is three business days; page8 courtesy-case-law sentence has a double negative with four business days. Preserve both, without resolving intent.
Profile inquiry form coexists with procedure sectionA requiring communications by email; preserve both channels without declaring precedence.

gaps: No stated revision/effective date in reviewed PDFs; AOSC25-30 link label is not treated as this document revision date.
No dedicated judge email or assistant-only phone established.
